S.FORM: iiku miana ia, s<in>u-raru ni-pu-tumulu sua cakəran, mata-sanai ara-təsəkə tiʔiŋ mu-kusa=ku cakəran pi-nalupu.
S.PHON: iiku miana ia ʂinuraru niputumuɾu sua ʦakəran matasanai aratəsəkə tiʔiŋ mukusaku ʦakəran pinaɾupu
S.FORM: iiku miana ia, s<in>uraru niputumuru sua cakeran, matasanai arateseke ti'ing mukusaku cakeran pinarupu.
S.PHON: iiku miana ia ʂinu[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]u niputumu[r|ɾ]u sua ʦake[r|ɾ]an matasanai a[r|ɾ]ateseke tiʔiŋ mukusaku ʦake[r|ɾ]an pina[r|ɾ]upu
S.TRANSL: In the old days, when there was a typhoon and high level water in the river, I would go fishing when the water level became lower and the water became clear.

S.FORM: cu-culu vutukulu i-tumulu, kaʔaməcə paakia ka-vaŋvaŋ.
S.PHON: ʦuʦuɾu vutukuɾu itumuɾu kaʔaməʦə paakia kavaŋvaŋ
S.FORM: cucuru vutukuru itumuru, ka'amece paakia kavangvang.
S.PHON: ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u vutuku[r|ɾ]u itumu[r|ɾ]u kaʔameʦe paakia kavaŋvaŋ
S.TRANSL: There were really plenty of fish and they were all big ones.

S.FORM: saian maamia ka-vaŋvaŋ cu-culu vutukulu.
S.PHON: saian maamia kavaŋvaŋ ʦuʦuɾu vutukuɾu
S.FORM: saian maamia kavangvang cucuru vutukuru.
S.PHON: saian maamia kavaŋvaŋ ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u vutuku[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: All the fish were varicorhinus barbatulus (a fresh water fish sp.).

S.FORM: mia-iisua ia, cu-culu kacaua.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia ʦuʦuɾu kaʦaua
S.FORM: miaiisua ia, cucuru kacaua.
S.PHON: miaiisua ia ʦuʦu[r|ɾ]u kaʦaua
S.TRANSL: There were really plenty of fish at that time.

S.FORM: mia-sua ia, ʔapacuʔ-ai ma-manu ma-ʔula ia, mu-a-kusa cakəran ka-vaŋvaŋ pi-nalupu.
S.PHON: miasua ia ʔapaʦuʔai mamanu maʔuɾa ia muakusa ʦakəran kavaŋvaŋ pinaɾupu
S.FORM: miasua ia, 'apacu'ai mamanu ma'ura ia, muakusa cakeran kavangvang pinarupu.
S.PHON: miasua ia ʔapaʦuʔai mamanu maʔu[r|ɾ]a ia muakusa ʦake[r|ɾ]an kavaŋvaŋ pina[r|ɾ]upu
S.TRANSL: In those days, even little kids would go fishing at the river.

S.FORM: mia-sua ia, tara-paipai-n cəʔəra-ən sua vutukulu.
S.PHON: miasua ia tarapaipain ʦəʔəraən sua vutukuɾu
S.FORM: miasua ia, tarapaipain ce'eraen sua vutukuru.
S.PHON: miasua ia ta[r|ɾ]apaipain ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aen sua vutuku[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: We could see nothing but the fish in those days.

S.FORM: mia-sua ia, sua iiku ia, vutukulu=aku puʔa-ən=aku.
S.PHON: miasua ia sua iiku ia vutukuɾuaku puʔaənaku
S.FORM: miasua ia, sua iiku ia, vutukuruaku pu'aenaku.
S.PHON: miasua ia sua iiku ia vutuku[r|ɾ]uaku puʔaenaku
S.TRANSL: In those days, I sold my fish.

S.FORM: apanapa nuu u-cani tuamarə.
S.PHON: apanapa nuu uʦani tuamarə
S.FORM: apanapa nuu ucani tuamare.
S.PHON: apanapa nuu uʦani tuama[r|ɾ]e
S.TRANSL: Sometimes I got a (full) basket (of fish).

S.FORM: sua iiku ia, kaʔan=ku pə-rəsəəvə ma-manəŋ.
S.PHON: sua iiku ia kaʔanku pərəsəəvə mamanəŋ
S.FORM: sua iiku ia, ka'anku pereseeve mamaneng.
S.PHON: sua iiku ia kaʔanku pe[r|ɾ]eseeve mamaneŋ
S.TRANSL: I had better not tell a lie.

S.FORM: si mia-sua ia, tavalaʔə ʔucaŋ=maku miciko.
S.PHON: ʂi miasua ia tavaɾaʔə ʔuʦaŋmaku mitʂiko
S.FORM: si miasua ia, tavara'e 'ucangmaku miciko.
S.PHON: ʂi miasua ia tava[r|ɾ]aʔe ʔuʦaŋmaku mitʂiko
S.TRANSL: Because my wife Michiko knows about that time.

S.FORM: si sua kaari isi ia, kaʔan=kia tavalaʔə pə-rəsəəvə.
S.PHON: ʂi sua kaari iʂi ia kaʔankia tavaɾaʔə pərəsəəvə
S.FORM: si sua kaari isi ia, ka'ankia tavara'e pereseeve.
S.PHON: ʂi sua kaa[r|ɾ]i iʂi ia kaʔankia tava[r|ɾ]aʔe pe[r|ɾ]eseeve
S.TRANSL: Because I cannot tell a lie about such a thing.

S.FORM: si ʔaisi sian khiojiu=maku ʔaisi um-ala kaari=mita.
S.PHON: ʂi ʔaiʂi ʂian khiojiumaku ʔaiʂi umaɾa kaarimita
S.FORM: si 'aisi sian khiojiumaku 'aisi umara kaarimita.
S.PHON: ʂi ʔaiʂi ʂian khiojiumaku ʔaiʂi uma[r|ɾ]a kaa[r|ɾ]imita
S.TRANSL: Because my professor is recording our words here.

S.FORM: iimu kaʔan=kia tavalaʔə pə-rəsəəvə
S.PHON: iimu kaʔankia tavaɾaʔə pərəsəəvə
S.FORM: iimu ka'ankia tavara'e pereseeve
S.PHON: iimu kaʔankia tava[r|ɾ]aʔe pe[r|ɾ]eseeve
S.TRANSL: Therefore, I cannot tell a lie.

S.FORM: iimu iikamu ia, t<um>imana-a kaari masi-kanakanavu.
S.PHON: iimu iikamu ia tumimanaa kaari maʂikanakanavu
S.FORM: iimu iikamu ia, t<um>imanaa kaari masikanakanavu.
S.PHON: iimu iikamu ia tumimanaa kaa[r|ɾ]i maʂikanakanavu
S.TRANSL: Therefore, you are to listen to (our) words and learn to speak Kanakanavu.

S.FORM: masi kaʔanə=kamu m-i-ʔaranasə.
S.PHON: maʂi kaʔanəkamu miʔaranasə
S.FORM: masi ka'anekamu mi'aranase.
S.PHON: maʂi kaʔanekamu miʔa[r|ɾ]anase

S.FORM: ŋuaci iisua kari=maku t<um>utulu.
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi iisua karimaku tumutuɾu
S.FORM: nguaci iisua karimaku t<um>uturu.
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi iisua ka[r|ɾ]imaku tumutu[r|ɾ]u

S.FORM: ara-siŋsiŋ-a. susumampai cuulu.
S.PHON: araʂiŋʂiŋa susumampai ʦuuɾu
S.FORM: arasingsinga. susumampai cuuru.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʂiŋʂiŋa susumampai ʦuu[r|ɾ]u
S.TRANSL: Stay healthy! Thank you very much.
